findings.title: `orchid notify`'s new `-*)` usage arm refuses a message text starting with a single dash that the broker's `notify` arm still admits (only `--*` is refused there), so a brokered escalation whose text opens with `-` dies instead of paging

`defer` is declared for every kind but names no operator verb, contradicting PROTOCOL.md's "each value names the operator verb that carries the decision out", and answering it marks the question answered so `orchid status --html` drops the blocker while the unchanged boundary record suppresses any further page
